caveats: JSON Mini and C programs use different representations/runtime structure (Mini UTF-16 strings, managed tree/collections vs custom C buffers/nodes), so treat JSON as representative workload, not a direct like-for-like implementation proof.
The 1.2x threshold is evaluated on these workloads only and is not a universal runtime bound.
All full expected stdout checks passed for the 11-round app matrix and both selfcompile variants emitted the existing expected C/MIR hashes.
